mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS notes, COALESCE(SUM(n.create_time >= #{d7}), 0) AS notesDelta7d, COALESCE(SUM(n.create_time >= #{today}), 0) AS notesToday FROM note_notes n WHERE n.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dirs, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.cnt IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS emptyDirs FROM note_directory d LEFT JOIN (SELECT dir_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM note_notes WHERE del_flag = '0' GROUP BY dir_id) c ON c.dir_id = d.id WHERE d.del_flag = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users, COALESCE(SUM(u.create_time >= #{weekStart}), 0) AS usersNewWeek FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS files, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(f.size) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024, 1), 0) AS storageGB, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(f.size) / 1024 / 1024 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1), 0) AS avgFileMB FROM basics_file f WHERE f.del_flag = '0'

SELECT t.cost_time FROM (SELECT o.cost_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.cost_time) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM sys_oper_log o WHERE o.oper_time >= #{from} AND o.oper_time < #{to} AND o.cost_time IS NOT NULL) t WHERE t.rn = CEIL(t.cnt * 0.95) LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.d, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(t.created) AS created, SUM(t.edited) AS edited FROM (SELECT DATE(n.create_time) AS d, COUNT(*) AS created, 0 AS edited FROM note_notes n WHERE n.del_flag = '0' AND n.create_time >= #{from} AND n.create_time < #{to} GROUP BY DATE(n.create_time) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(o.oper_time) AS d, 0 AS created, COUNT(*) AS edited FROM sys_oper_log o WHERE o.oper_time >= #{from} AND o.oper_time < #{to} AND o.business_type = 2 AND o.title = '笔记' GROUP BY DATE(o.oper_time)) t GROUP BY t.d ORDER BY t.d

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), '未归类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS notes, COALESCE(SUM(n.update_time >= #{d7}), 0) AS active7d FROM note_notes n LEFT JOIN note_directory d ON d.id = n.dir_id AND d.del_flag = '0' WHERE n.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY n.dir_id, d.name ORDER BY notes DESC

SELECT CASE l.client_key WHEN 'pc' THEN 'PC 客户端' WHEN 'app' THEN 'App 客户端' ELSE CONCAT('其他（', COALESCE(NULLIF(l.client_key, ''), '未知'), '）') END AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM sys_login_info l WHERE l.login_time >= #{from} AND l.login_time < #{to} AND l.status = '0' GROUP BY l.client_key ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN f.type LIKE 'image/%' THEN '图片' WHEN f.type LIKE 'video/%' THEN '视频' WHEN f.type LIKE 'audio/%' THEN '音频' WHEN f.type LIKE 'application/%' AND (f.type LIKE '%zip%' OR f.type LIKE '%rar%' OR f.type LIKE '%7z%' OR f.type LIKE '%gzip%' OR f.type LIKE '%tar%') THEN '压缩包' WHEN f.type LIKE 'text/%' OR f.type LIKE 'application/%' THEN '文档' ELSE '其他' END AS name, SUM(f.size) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 AS size, COUNT(*) AS `count` FROM basics_file f WHERE f.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY name ORDER BY size DESC

SELECT t.id AS id, t.name AS name, COALESCE(NULLIF(d.name, ''), '未归类') AS dirName, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.nick_name, ''), u.user_name, '未知') AS authorName, CHAR_LENGTH(n2.content) AS chars, DATE_FORMAT(t.update_time, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS updatedAt FROM (SELECT n.id, n.name, n.dir_id, n.update_by, n.update_time FROM note_notes n WHERE n.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY n.update_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}) t LEFT JOIN note_notes n2 ON n2.id = t.id LEFT JOIN note_directory d ON d.id = t.dir_id AND d.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = t.update_by ORDER BY t.update_time DESC
